aboutText: Based in Clifton Hill, Jett Electrical brings years of experience to every project. We recently assisted a homeowner in transforming their cellar into a modern studio apartment, demonstrating our expertise in handling complex electrical needs while adhering to budget constraints. Our electricians are up-to-date with the latest innovations and possess the skills to implement them effectively. We take pride in being an intelligent, careful, and professional company that the Clifton Hill community can trust for all their electrical requirements.
servicesText: At Jett Electrical, we offer a wide range of electrical services tailored to the needs of Clifton Hill residents and businesses. From residential wiring to commercial installations, our team ensures safe, efficient, and modern electrical systems. We specialise in both new constructions and renovations, providing reliable service across the suburb.
